crossRefs.note: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

translations.web: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
translations.bsb: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
translations.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
translations.asv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.
